title: Asphalt Paver Rental for Crestwood Annual Training
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU.JFHQ USPFO IL.USPFO IL PROCUREMENT.W7M6 USPFO ACTIVITY IL ARNG
description_text: The 2118th Asphalt Detachment requires the short-term rental of one (1) commercial-grade crawler asphalt paver to complete the paving of a Physical Training Track during Annual Training at the Crestwood Armory in Robbins, IL. This is a “dry lease” requirement where the Government will provide the operator and fuel.
